content.text:
## Callisto vs. Lumen — ecosystem setup

Surveyed `~/Projects/callisto`'s justfile, Cargo.toml, deny.toml, `.moon/tasks/rust.yml`, and CI workflows against Lumen's equivalents.

### Already matches — no action
- **Centralized `[workspace.lints]`** — Lumen's `Cargo.toml:75-91` is near-identical to callisto's (`unsafe_code`, `unused_must_use`, the same clippy allow/deny set through `map_err_ignore`), plus 3 extra cast-lint allows. Already consolidated, not duplicated per-crate. Nothing to do here.
- **Layer-licensing containment** (`deny.toml` bans check via `.moon/tasks/rust.yml`'s `deny` task) — Lumen actually has more here than callisto: a bans-based check enforcing lumen-model/lumen-session never depend on the FSL-licensed crates. Callisto doesn't need this (single license). Lumen-specific strength, not a gap.

### Gap 1 — lint/test still pay the lock-contention tax callisto already fixed for itself
Lumen's `justfile` `lint`/`test` call `moon run :lint` / `moon run :test`, which fan out through `.moon/tasks/rust.yml` to one `cargo clippy -p $project` / `cargo test -p $project` **per crate** (7 separate processes), all locking the same shared `target/` dir. Callisto's own justfile has this exact bug, already fixed, with a comment explaining it:

```
# Moon's per-project `cargo clippy -p $project` tasks all lock the same shared
# target/ dir, so running them one-per-project serializes on Cargo's own build
# lock instead of parallelizing — a single --workspace invocation lets Cargo's
# internal job scheduler parallelize across crates instead.
lint:
    cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
```

Callisto's `test` similarly prefers `cargo nextest run --workspace` (falling back to moon) over the per-crate fan-out. `cargo-nextest` is already installed locally (`~/.cargo/bin/cargo-nextest`).

**Proposal:** mirror callisto's `lint` + `lint-affected` recipes, and switch `test` to nextest-first with moon fallback.

### Gap 2 — no unused-dependency check, and this bit us already
This session's own audit found 6 unused dependencies across 3 crates (rayon/memmap2 in lumen-analysis, smallvec/tracing in lumen-store, simd-json/memmap2 in lumen-session) — found by manual review. `cargo-machete` (already installed) catches exactly this class of drift automatically. Callisto runs it as `just machete`.

**Proposal:** add `just machete: cargo machete`, wire into `ci:`.

### Explicitly not recommending — cargo-semver-checks
Callisto's whole purpose is changeset/version management, so SemVer enforcement is load-bearing there. Lumen doesn't publish any crate externally yet — pre-release, single consumer. Standing project memory from earlier this session (the ReadContractEnvelope/migration-chain build-then-revert) is specifically about not building premature versioning scaffolding before a real consumer exists. Adding SemVer gating now would be the same mistake in a new shape. Revisit if/when a Lumen crate actually gets published.

### Lower priority
- **`doc-check`** (`RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps --workspace`) — cheap, callisto has it, Lumen doesn't. Given how thorough Lumen's doc comments already are, this catches broken intra-doc links for free.
- **`cargo-mutants`** — already installed, and Lumen already gets mutation testing via the `lambda:mutator` agent during implementation. A standalone `just mutants` would just make it repeatable outside that workflow. Already substantially covered.
- **`cargo-llvm-cov` coverage reporting** — callisto has it in CI, Lumen doesn't. Nice-to-have, not a known gap.
- **Dead config**: `rust-toolchain.toml` targets `wasm32-unknown-unknown`, but nothing in any Cargo.toml or doc references wasm anywhere in the repo. Either leftover template config or a real future direction — worth asking rather than silently dropping.

### Proposal, in order
1. Fix the lint/test lock-contention (mirror callisto's validated fix)
2. Add `cargo-machete` (directly closes a gap we already paid for once)
3. Add `doc-check` (cheap, matches callisto)
4. Skip `cargo-semver-checks` for now — revisit at first real publish
5. Ask about the dead `wasm32` toolchain target

Want me to implement 1–3 now?

content.text:
Good calls on both:

- **Semver-checks**: worth noting one mechanical detail — `cargo semver-checks check-release` diffs against the last **published** crates.io version, so it'll have nothing to compare against until each crate's first publish (no-op or error on a never-published crate). Wiring it in now is still the right call — it goes live starting with each crate's second release, and you want the recipe in place before the first one, not scrambling to add it after.

# Default recipe: run full CI pipeline via moon & just
default: ci

# ── Build ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
build:
    moon run :build

build-release:
    cargo build --release --workspace

# ── Test ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# nextest runs the whole workspace as one process (proper parallelism, no
# per-crate build-lock contention); falls back to moon's per-project fan-out
# if nextest isn't installed. Same pattern callisto validated in its own justfile.
test:
    cargo nextest run --workspace || moon run :test
    cargo test --doc

# ── Lint & Format ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
check: fmt-check lint

# Single workspace invocation. Moon's per-project `cargo clippy -p $project` tasks
# (.moon/tasks/rust.yml) all lock the same shared target/ dir, so running them
# one-per-project serializes on Cargo's own build lock instead of parallelizing --
# a single --workspace invocation lets Cargo's internal job scheduler parallelize
# across crates instead. Same fix callisto already applied to its own justfile.
lint:
    cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

# Lint only projects affected by changes since the base branch, still via one
# cargo invocation (not moon's per-project fan-out) to avoid the same build-lock
# serialization while skipping unaffected crates entirely.
lint-affected:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    projects=$(moon query projects --affected 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.projects[].id')
    if [ -z "$projects" ]; then
        echo "No projects affected — skipping lint."
        exit 0
    fi
    args=()
    for p in $projects; do args+=(-p "$p"); done
    cargo clippy "${args[@]}" --all-targets -- -D warnings

# ── Licensing / Dependency Policy ────────────────────────────────────────────
deny:
    moon run :deny

# Unused-dependency check. Directly closes the gap that let 6 unused deps across
# 3 crates (rayon/memmap2, smallvec/tracing, simd-json/memmap2) go unnoticed
# until a manual audit found them.
machete:
    cargo machete

# ── API Surface ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Verifies public API changes against the last-published crates.io version.
# NOT wired into `ci:` yet: cargo-semver-checks needs a published baseline to
# diff against, and no Lumen crate has been published yet -- running this
# before a first publish exists just fails with no baseline. Wire into `ci:`
# once the first crate is on crates.io; until then, run manually pre-release.
check-api:
    cargo semver-checks check-release

# Documentation build check (warnings treated as errors) -- catches broken
# intra-doc links for free.
doc-check:
    RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps --workspace

fmt:
    moon run :format

format: fmt

fmt-check:
    moon run :format-check

# ── Continuous Development & Clean ──────────────────────────────────────────
clean:
    moon clean 2>/dev/null || true
    cargo clean

# ── Git Hooks & Pre-push ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
pre-commit: fmt-check

pre-push: fmt-check lint-affected

hooks:
    @echo '#!/bin/sh\njust pre-commit' > .git/hooks/pre-commit
    @chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
    @echo '#!/bin/sh\njust pre-push' > .git/hooks/pre-push
    @chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-push
    @echo "Git pre-commit and pre-push hooks installed successfully."

ci: fmt-check lint deny machete doc-check test

file.content:
# Default recipe: run full CI pipeline via moon & just
default: ci

# ── Build ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
build:
    moon run :build

build-release:
    cargo build --release --workspace

# ── Test ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# nextest runs the whole workspace as one process (proper parallelism, no
# per-crate build-lock contention); falls back to moon's per-project fan-out
# if nextest isn't installed. Same pattern callisto validated in its own justfile.
test:
    cargo nextest run --workspace || moon run :test
    cargo test --doc

# ── Lint & Format ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
check: fmt-check lint

# Single workspace invocation. Moon's per-project `cargo clippy -p $project` tasks
# (.moon/tasks/rust.yml) all lock the same shared target/ dir, so running them
# one-per-project serializes on Cargo's own build lock instead of parallelizing --
# a single --workspace invocation lets Cargo's internal job scheduler parallelize
# across crates instead. Same fix callisto already applied to its own justfile.
lint:
    cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

# Lint only projects affected by changes since the base branch, still via one
# cargo invocation (not moon's per-project fan-out) to avoid the same build-lock
# serialization while skipping unaffected crates entirely.
lint-affected:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    projects=$(moon query projects --affected 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.projects[].id')
    if [ -z "$projects" ]; then
        echo "No projects affected — skipping lint."
        exit 0
    fi
    args=()
    for p in $projects; do args+=(-p "$p"); done
    cargo clippy "${args[@]}" --all-targets -- -D warnings

# ── Licensing / Dependency Policy ────────────────────────────────────────────
deny:
    moon run :deny

# Unused-dependency check. Directly closes the gap that let 6 unused deps across
# 3 crates (rayon/memmap2, smallvec/tracing, simd-json/memmap2) go unnoticed
# until a manual audit found them.
machete:
    cargo machete

# ── API Surface ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Verifies public API changes against the last-published crates.io version.
# NOT wired into `ci:` yet: cargo-semver-checks needs a published baseline to
# diff against, and no Lumen crate has been published yet -- running this
# before a first publish exists just fails with no baseline. Wire into `ci:`
# once the first crate is on crates.io; until then, run manually pre-release.
check-api:
    cargo semver-checks check-release

# Documentation build check (warnings treated as errors) -- catches broken
# intra-doc links for free.
doc-check:
    RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps --workspace

# ── Pricing Data (CRIT-LUMEN-170) ────────────────────────────────────────────
# Refreshes the vendored LiteLLM pricing snapshot lumen-model's PricingTable::seed() loads at
# compile time. Never fetched live -- Lumen prices historical sessions and needs point-in-time-
# stable rates, so this is a periodic, explicit re-vendor step, not a per-request fetch. Review
# the diff (especially any rate change for a currently-seeded model) before committing.
update-pricing:
    curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/main/model_prices_and_context_window.json \
        -o crates/lumen-model/data/litellm_model_prices.json

fmt:
    moon run :format

format: fmt

fmt-check:
    moon run :format-check

# ── Continuous Development & Clean ──────────────────────────────────────────
clean:
    moon clean 2>/dev/null || true
    cargo clean

# ── Git Hooks & Pre-push ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
pre-commit: fmt-check

pre-push: fmt-check lint-affected

hooks:
    @echo '#!/bin/sh\njust pre-commit' > .git/hooks/pre-commit
    @chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
    @echo '#!/bin/sh\njust pre-push' > .git/hooks/pre-push
    @chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-push
    @echo "Git pre-commit and pre-push hooks installed successfully."

# ── CI Verification Pipeline ───────────────────────────────────────────────
ci: fmt-check lint deny machete doc-check test

description: "Lumen's justfile/moon/cargo setup was compared against orin-dx/callisto (same stack, more mature) and hardened: fixed a lint/test lock-contention bug callisto already fixed, added cargo-machete/doc-check/semver-checks gates. Read this if touching justfile, CI, or Cargo.toml dependency lists."

  modified: 2026-08-23

## What changed (commits 7c8e615, 570d62c, 1644800, same session as the CRIT-LUMEN-170/171/172/174 work)

Compared `~/Projects/lumen`'s build tooling against `~/Projects/callisto` (orin-dx/callisto's own repo, same moon+cargo+justfile stack, more battle-tested). Found and fixed:

1. **`lint`/`test` were paying a lock-contention tax callisto already fixed.** Both called `moon run :X`, which fans out to one `cargo clippy -p $project` / `cargo test -p $project` per crate -- all serializing on the same shared `target/` dir's build lock. Fixed to match callisto: `lint` is now a single `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` invocation; `test` uses `cargo nextest run --workspace` (falls back to moon if nextest isn't installed). `lint-affected` (used by `pre-push`) gets the same single-invocation treatment, scoped to moon's affected-project list.
2. **Added `cargo-machete`** (unused-dep check) to `just machete`, wired into `ci:`. Immediately found **16 unused dependencies across 5 crates** -- nearly 3x the 6 a manual audit found earlier this session. All spot-checked against real source (zero references, including tests/benches) and removed. `lumen-cli` depending on `lumen-analysis`/`lumen-pattern` with zero usage traces back to commit 94f051c (CLI rebuilt around lumen-store, old trace/audit/scan commands removed, Cargo.toml lines never cleaned up).
3. **Added `doc-check`** (`RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings cargo doc --workspace`), wired into `ci:`. Found 3 real doc-build errors: two intra-doc links to private items in `pricing.rs`, one unescaped `<worker>` in `transcript.rs` parsed as an HTML tag. Fixed.
4. **Added `check-api`** (`cargo semver-checks check-release`) -- **deliberately NOT wired into `ci:` yet**. It diffs against the last-published crates.io version; no Lumen crate has been published yet, so it currently errors with no baseline. User confirmed publishing is starting soon, so the recipe is in place now -- **wire it into `ci:` the moment the first crate publishes**, and run `just check-api` manually before each release until then.
5. **Dropped the `wasm32-unknown-unknown` target** from `rust-toolchain.toml` -- confirmed via grep, zero references anywhere in the repo (Cargo.toml files, docs). Was dead config, not a real requirement.

## What callisto has that Lumen deliberately does NOT need
- Centralized `[workspace.lints]` -- Lumen already had this, near-identical to callisto's, before this pass. Not a gap.
- callisto's `wasm-check`/fuzz targets -- specific to callisto being a moon plugin; not applicable to Lumen.
- `cargo-mutants` as a standing recipe -- Lumen already gets mutation testing via the `lambda:mutator` agent during implementation; lower priority, not added.
- `cargo-llvm-cov` coverage reporting -- callisto has it in CI, Lumen doesn't; nice-to-have, not a known gap, not added.

## Lumen has something callisto doesn't
A bans-based layer-licensing check (`.moon/tasks/rust.yml`'s `deny` task, backed by `deny.toml`) enforcing `lumen-model`/`lumen-session` never depend on the FSL-licensed crates. Callisto doesn't need this (single license). See [[project_lumen_prism_sibling_repos]] and AGENTS.md for the unresolved dev-dependency edge of this same rule.

See also [[project_lumen_session_2026_08_22_status_and_backlog]] for the feature-work backlog this build-tooling pass ran alongside.

## Summary

Compared Lumen's build tooling against `~/Projects/callisto` and hardened it, 3 commits:

1. **`7c8e615`** — Fixed the same lint/test lock-contention bug callisto already found and fixed (per-crate `moon run :lint`/`:test` fan-out serializing on Cargo's shared build lock → single `--workspace` invocation, `nextest` for tests). Added `machete`, `doc-check`, `check-api` recipes, wired the first two into `ci:`. `check-api` stays out of `ci:` for now — confirmed it errors with no baseline since nothing's published yet; you said publishing's coming, so it's in place and ready to wire in the moment the first crate goes out. Dropped the dead `wasm32-unknown-unknown` toolchain target.
2. **`570d62c`** — `cargo-machete` immediately found 16 unused deps (not 6) across 5 crates. Spot-checked the surprising ones against real source before touching anything, confirmed zero false positives, removed all 16. Full workspace build (including tests/benches) and all 190 tests verified green after.
3. **`1644800`** — `doc-check` found 3 real doc-build errors (two broken intra-doc links to private items, one doc comment parsed as an unclosed HTML tag). Fixed.

`just ci` runs clean end to end. Memory updated with the findings and the `check-api` follow-up so it's not forgotten at first publish.
